taxes.tax: Per-worker fees on employers (work permits of foreign workers)
unsupported: 3000 taxes on payroll and workforce: work-permit fees for foreign workers (Labour Law 7/2000; not read); no payroll tax in the laws read (DL 8/2011 income tax, DL 26/2024 VAT). Coordinator decision of pass 3l: OECD 3000 covers taxes paid by employers as a fixed amount per person employed, so a per-worker fee levied by law on employers belongs here and the heading is not cited absent until the fee text is read; a one-off permit issuance charge that does not scale with the workforce is not a tax (note only). No company input carries the workforce by nationality. Grade C (pass 3l).
